However, the systems and staffing at the surgery have significantly declined. The shift to using E-Consult exclusively as the first point of contact has made accessing care unnecessarily difficult. Worse still, the triage and responses are now outsourced to a third-party provider, which can choose to not forward important patient information to the surgery. In some cases, they redirect the issue to NHS 111, effectively removing the patient’s right to be treated by their own GP. This is neither a safe nor patient-centred system.

Reception staff are mixed—some are polite and extremely helpful, while others are astonishingly unprofessional. Recently, one receptionist told me I was “lucky” they were willing to pass on a message to my mother’s doctor. Today, despite being instructed by a different receptionist to bring in a urine sample for my mother (which I did at the earliest opportunity, considering her condition), the receptionist on duty flatly refused to accept it or pass it to the doctor, for a simple dipstick test that the doctor could carry out in a minute. Instead, I was met with an obstructive attitude, delivered with utter contempt. A total lack of concern of the impact of their jobsworth attitude. It took the practice manager to intervene and take the sample in for the doctor to check.

This kind of behaviour shows a complete lack of compassion and an alarming disregard for the needs of extremely vulnerable patients. It’s deeply concerning that individuals displaying this level of indifference are working in frontline roles in an NHS GP surgery.",null,[0,176]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xnMFZsRm9UVjlSUzBsalVXTkhTbmhqVFZSamNVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x79003bd7641b02e2!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlg0VlFoTV9RS0ljUWNHSnhjTVRjcUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xnMFZsRm9UVjlSUzBsalVXTkhTbmhqVFZSamNVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjJgYKG5LKTAxUld4QGHdABBz4QoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjJgYKG5LKTAxUld4QGHdABBz4Q0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpHWXkxZlgxOWZSV2hETFd4T2RucDFOMjQ0Y0ZKcVFraFNXVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEphYTBOYU5IQk9ZMnRKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT20xMkxUSXllRk56T0dSaGJreEVjazA0UzJkV1JXYxAB",["0x0:0x79003bd7641b02e2",null,1752095836534100,1752095836534100,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108735046733885261257/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Nigel H","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLbHFIXiRhq7RD6mbK4-9RsU6wOzbttVn5YncYXMKQJklMpEg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/108735046733885261257?hl=en"],"108735046733885261257",null,2,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjJgYKG5LKTAxUld4QGHdABBz4Q7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"8 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["This is an outstanding surgery.
